text:
oliver.sre: incident-bot just paged P1 — inference-serving error-rate spike in us-west-2 (>5% over baseline). paging oncall now.
incident-bot: [ALERT] P1 inference-serving: error_rate > 5% (us-west-2) — triggered at 2026-03-15T14:32:25Z — pager: @mike_oncall — runbook: /runbooks/inference-error-rate.md :rotating_light:

mike_oncall: on it. looking at Grafana now, pulling logs. any obvious deploys?
oliver.sre: no deploys flagged in the last 30m per deploy-bot. could be model KV cache pressure or backend timeout cascade.
deply-bot: rollback none — last deploy 2026-03-15T13:50:12Z to model-sidecar (model-v2.1).
mike_oncall: ok. initial triage: 1) error-rate concentrated on inference-worker-*/us-west-2 2) tail latency increasing 3) request queue length spiking.
sophia.platform: linking panels: https://grafana.internal/d/abc123/inference-overview?orgId=1 :eyes:

lia_support: customers reporting slow response times in multi-tenant apps. not widespread but several support tickets open. severity: customer-impacting (timeout retries visible).
mike_oncall: creating a suppression for the noisy transient alerts on non-critical infra so we can focus on the root P1. will keep the main SLO alert active. (/alerts mute)
mike_oncall: temporarily silenced alert group: infra-transient-errors for 30m.
oliver.sre: can we triage cause quickly — cache eviction, network, or model OOM?
mike_oncall: logs show increased "kv_get_miss" and "cache_miss" lines around spike. sending a capture of one worker log:```[2026-03-15T14:30:12Z] ERROR inference: request_id=abc123 kv_get_miss=true backend_timeout_ms=1200 downstream_retries=1 stack=...```

sophia.platform: that points to prefix/KV caching regressions. maybe eviction thresholds are too low for our new batch size. I'll check runtime config (redis/hosted-kv) and bin packing metrics.
mike_oncall: also seeing model-fallback counts: 37 fallbacks to cpu-quantized in the last 10m — maybe gpu memory pressure.
lia_support: pinged product-ops: customer-impact note sent to concierge, ETA on next update ~ 30m.

oliver.sre: short mitigations: 1) scale up inference-worker-asg for us-west-2 + add capacity 2) increase KV cache size or adjust eviction policy 3) temporary routing to us-east-1 for new requests if safe. who can own each?
sophia.platform: I'll handle KV config and scale up ASG (30% now). kicking off scaling command:```aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name inference-worker-us-west-2 --desired-capacity 120```
sophia.platform: ASG scale started, ETA ~90s for new instances to warm.
mike_oncall: I'm going to alter the alert threshold for the noisy per-worker error rate to avoid constant re-paging while we scale. changing rule: error_rate for per-worker from 3%->6% window 1m->3m. (will revert in post-incident). query used:```sum(rate(inference_errors_total{region="us-west-2"}[1m])) by (instance) / sum(rate(inference_requests_total{region="us-west-2"}[1m])) by (instance) > 0.06```
mike_oncall: patched alert rule (temporary) and created ticket to revert: INC-2305-14.

deploy-bot: automated routing policy: increased fallback_capacity to 20% for us-west-2.
oliver.sre: good. also enable stricter fallback to known-good model variant for high-latency requests so customers don't see errors.
mike_oncall: enabled fallback policy — requests exceeding 900ms now route to model-v2.0-fallback.

lia_support: doing quick customer-impact tally: ~12 tickets, 3 paying customers with SLA alerts. flagged for priority follow-up.

sophia.platform: while scaling finishes, I'm going to sketch a dedicated incident dashboard for retrospectives so next time we can jump straight to the important panels. proposed dashboard id: "retro-inference-uswest-230501". panels to include: - golden signals: requests/sec, error-rate, latency p50/p95/p99 - queue length / token queue depth - KV cache hit/miss rate (prefix vs global) - model fallback counts by reason - GPU memory pressure + OOM rate - per-instance request rate and error_rate - sampling of example request ids and traces (link to traces) - recent deploys/rollouts pane - current alert triggers + muted alerts list
mike_oncall: love it. can you add drilldowns for each panel to go to logs/traces/trace-id? e.g., click p99 -> open jaeger filter for that time window.
sophia.platform: yes — plan to add panel links. queries I'll use (examples):
```
# error rate per instance (1m)
sum(rate(inference_errors_total{region="us-west-2"}[1m])) by (instance) / sum(rate(inference_requests_total{region="us-west-2"}[1m])) by (instance)

# KV cache hit ratio (5m)
sum(rate(kv_cache_hits_total{cache="prefix"}[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_requests_total{cache="prefix"}[5m]))

# queue length
sum(inference_request_queue_length{region="us-west-2"})
```

oliver.sre: also add a panel for "sustained error burst" detection (histogram of errors over 1m windows) and one for "alert noise score" (count of flapping alerts). that'll help tuning.

mike_oncall: quick handoff: I need to step out in 15m. oliver.sre — can you take on the next 30m until Sophia confirms KV changes and ASG warm?
oliver.sre: taking handoff. keeping incident channel updated. mike, leave any open commands in the ticket.
mike_oncall: putting short summary in INC-2305-14: mitigation steps, temp alert changes, ASG bump, KV change in progress, fallback policy enabled, customer-impact note posted.

(some time passes)
sophia.platform: ASG warm complete, new instances healthy. KV cache size bumped by 40% and eviction TTL adjusted — monitoring.
sophia.platform: error-rate dropping to ~0.8% now, latency p99 back to ~450ms from 1.2s.

lia_support: customers notified that service is recovering. closing immediate customer tickets as appropriate.
mike_oncall: thanks team. removing temporary alert mute early. will keep main SLO watch for 1h.

oliver.sre: next steps for post-incident: 1) build the retro Grafana dashboard (sophia) 2) add permanent alert tuning RFC (mike) 3) run a replay of traffic on staging with new cache settings (infra) 4) postmortem draft in #postmortems with timeline + customer impact (lia). owners + due dates in INC-2305-14.
sophia.platform: starting dashboard now — will add panels and drilldowns, invite anyone for review. aiming for dashboard draft in 24h.
mike_oncall: and I'll revert the temporary alert threshold changes after we confirm stability, leaving notes in the rule.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2305 opened by mike_oncall at 2026-03-15T14:32:46Z — severity P1 — linked channel: #eng-oncall — status: mitigated -> monitoring.

oliver.sre: thanks everyone. good quick mitigation. we'll schedule retro to tighten golden signals and ensure cache capacity matches burst patterns. :thumbsup:
